artworks.title: A Review on the Champs de Mars
artworks.medium: gouache
artworks.description: The image features a park setting where people are gathered for a formal event. The horizon is marked by trees, and a classical structure with columns is in the background. Dynamic clouds fill the sky, while elegantly dressed individuals are seen mingling along a pathway. Closer to the viewer, groups of people are gathered, with some climbing a tree and a man on a horse to the right. The scene is depicted in soft colors, with blues, greens, whites, browns, and pastel shades conveying a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a horizon framed by green foliage and trees. The sky above is a clear blue. The painting features soft earthy tones with hints of green vegetation and rustic cottages. In the foreground, there are scattered wooden objects, and in the distance, small human figures near the cottages.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a rustic building to the right side, a statue on a pedestal to the left, a body of water, a boat with two figures, trees blending into the sky, a soft brushstroke style, a color palette of muted blues and earthy tones, and a dreamy, tranquil effect.

artworks.title: Panoramic View across a Terraced Park
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. In the foreground, there is a terrace with small figures moving about. In the background, there are mountains under a pale blue sky with clouds. The painting style is realistic with clear details. The color palette includes muted tones of green, blue, and earth colors. Trees and greenery dot the land in the distance. Statues flank the terrace, adding grandeur to the scene.

artworks.title: Mill with Bridge and Figures
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a house, path, water, bridge, figures, trees, and clouds. The house has a thatched roof and beige walls. A path leads to the water's edge where wooden beams and barrels are. A stream flows behind the house, crossed by a small bridge with two figures. In the distance, another thatched building is seen through the trees. The style includes fluid brushstrokes for the trees and foliage. Earth tones and muted greens dominate the color palette. The sky has washes of light gray and beige.

artworks.title: Park View
artworks.medium: gouache over graphite on vellum
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 28 x 22.5 cm (11 x 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a garden scene with a sloping path, tall trees, a temple in the distance, and intricate foliage. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the dappled light. The color palette is soft with shades of green, blue, white, and pastel hues. A woman, child, and a white dog are near a balustrade in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Potager of the Hôtel de Valentinois in Passy
artworks.medium: gouache over graphite on linen
artworks.description: The image shows a formal garden viewed from slightly above ground level. A pathway lined with ornate, fenced plots filled with lush vegetation is visible. Tall trees stretch across the horizon, with a stately building on the left. In the distance, a statue serves as a central focal point along the pathway. The artwork features fine and precise brushstrokes depicting the architecture, flora, and figures. The color palette includes earthy browns and greens for the vegetation, creamy tones for the building, and soft blue and white hues for the sky, dotted with clouds. People in historical clothing are leisurely strolling the pathways.

artworks.title: A French Gentleman Standing
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure in a dynamic pose. The man is standing with one foot forward and turning his upper body to the side, while his head is slightly turned away from the viewer, revealing the profile view of his face. He has a prominent nose, hair styled back into a small ponytail or queue typical of the 18th century, and is wearing a three-cornered hat, a long coat, knee-length breeches, and stockings. The man's coat appears voluminous with visible folds, and one arm is slightly bent and placed on his hip. The background is a plain, neutral paper texture.

artworks.title: Charitable Ladies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a street scene with a stone building and an obelisk. The painting shows figures interacting near a window and on the ground. The building has a striped awning and a fountain with water flowing from a lion's head. Debris and garments are scattered around the fountain. In the background, there is an obelisk with visible hieroglyphs. The figures are engaged in a performance or exchange, with a person playing a musical instrument and a dog sitting nearby. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo.

artworks.title: The Peasant Dance
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash and black chalk over a black chalk counterproof, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene in a rustic setting. The room has a high ceiling with exposed wooden beams and a large window. Various figures are engaged in dancing, playing music, and observing. To the left, a character plays a flute while standing on a barrel. In the foreground, a dancer appears in mid-motion. The figures are clustered around the central dancer, some holding hands and others leaning against barrels. In the background, a ladder reaches up to a loft area where additional objects are stored. The atmosphere is festive yet intimate, with a focus on movement and engagement among the elements in the image.

artworks.title: Ruined Farm
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash, and blue watercolor, over a black chalk counterproof, with black chalk additions, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an interior view of a rustic barn with a partially open roof. Four figures are at a table, surrounded by agricultural objects. The wooden framework and exposed thatch roof are prominent. The open roof reveals a clear blue sky with clouds. The color palette is earthy, with delicate brushstrokes highlighting details. The composition leads the eye upward through the structure towards the sky, while the figures below add activity to the scene.

artworks.title: The Seesaw
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with various elements. On the left, there is a grand structure with columns, potentially a temple, partly covered with ivy. A stone bridge crosses a stream in the middle, while trees frame the right side. The top of the image shows a horizon with clouds blending into the tree line. In the scene, figures are seen engaged in various activities, such as leading a horse, reclining on the grass, and interacting near the water. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, emphasizing movement and texture. The color scheme includes blues, greens, and earthy tones, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Louis XVI and Marie-Antoinette Crowned by Love
artworks.medium: red chalk, black chalk, pen and black and gray ink with watercolor and gouache, heightened with white gouache on laid paper

artworks.title: Figure Sketches
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and red and black chalk with gray and brown wash on two overlapping sheets of  laid paper
artworks.description: This abstract composition features flowing, curved lines and soft, blurred shapes that create figures and profiles. On the right, a sinuous, reclining figure with red and orange contouring resembles a human form. To the left, a sketched blue outline of a smaller figure is present, along with two abstract shapes above it.

artworks.title: Loaned Kiss
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of three figures in an outdoor setting. The image shows two figures having a conversation or altercation, while a third figure stands between them. The background features trees, a sculpted bust, a stairway, flowers, and leaves. The figures are wearing historical clothing. Two small onlookers are in the background. The style is reminiscent of Thomas Rowlandson, known for satirical and narrative illustrations.

artworks.title: The Kiss Returned
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, watercolor, and gouache

artworks.title: Port Scene
artworks.medium: watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts an archway under a large stone tower structure, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The scene descends towards a dock area. The horizon is obscured by the towering structures, but the dock scene with sailing ships can be seen in the distance through the archway. The brushstrokes create a textured effect on the stone surfaces and figures. The color palette is muted, with grays, blues, and earthy tones. Close to us, people are gathered on steps, some seated on what appear to be large sacks or bundles, while others are moving or interacting. Further back, beyond the archway, boats are visible, populated with figures engaged in activity, creating a lively harbor scene.

artworks.title: Three Studies of a Woman's Head and a Study of Hands [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk and graphite with black chalk and pink wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting three women's upper bodies in various orientations across the composition. Each woman has distinct facial features, including rounded cheeks and subtle lips. Their hair is styled with gentle curls framing their faces. They are shown wearing draped clothing typical of an artistic study. Two hands are drawn touching intricately in the center of the composition. There are no defined background elements in the sketch.

artworks.title: View of a House, a Cottage, and Two Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a slightly elevated point of view, providing a full perspective. The horizon is not clearly defined, with the roof lines and trees indicating a settled landscape in the distance. The drawing uses delicate brushstrokes to convey texture and form in a sepia color palette. In the foreground, there are haystacks and a shelter with two figures. To the left, there is a building with a sloping roof and trees. The sky above has faintly drawn clouds.

artworks.title: The Lute Player
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person seated in a three-quarter view turned to the side, with their upper body twisting slightly toward the viewer. The person has curly hair, while their facial features are delicately sketched. The individual is dressed in a flowing garment, and they hold a musical instrument. The background is plain and unadorned, with brown-toned shading and subtle texture.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats Along Quay, Noank, Conn.
artworks.medium: etching on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows sailboats docked along a wooden pier in a harbor. Two weathered wooden buildings are on the right side near the water. The horizon is low, with boat masts reaching upwards. The style features etching strokes giving texture to water, reflections, and structures in a monochromatic color palette. A small rocky shoreline is seen in the distance.

artworks.title: The Rialto, Venice
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image features a canal scene with a focus on an arch bridge across the water. The perspective is from the canal's edge, facing the bridge. There are figures on the bridge and moored boats near the viewer. The artwork is done with fine, detailed brushstrokes resembling an etching style. The colors are sepia tones, and the background shows city structures.

artworks.title: Whistler's House, Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
artworks.description: The image is a detailed etching of a waterfront scene captured from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is just above the row of buildings lining the water. The scene shows several figures engaged in various activities on the left, with rooflines and chimneys spearing the skyline against a softly cloudy sky. In the distance to the right, a bridge extends across the water. The artist uses fine, delicate lines to render the architecture and figures with precision, making rowboats and barges appear motionless on calm waters. The overall palette is monochrome, emphasizing detailed line work and offering a classic, timeless atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: Eight Bells
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John W. Beatty, Jr.
